text:
maria_cs: Vireo (beta) ping 4: two stakeholders can't see seat counts in the console and some invites show 'expired' after they accepted. They're worried this will kill the exec pilot review. Can we triage and schedule a quick enablement + feedback capture?

dan_eng: On it. Org VR0-51? Any logs from the console?

maria_cs: Org VR0-51. Customer pasted a screenshot showing total seats=12 but active=9 and 3 users listed as 'accepted (link expired)'.

dan_eng: Quick check: `admin seats status --org VR0-51` -> found 3 accounts with mismatched meta (accepted but token not provisioned). Pushing small sync to reconcile seat state now.

deploy-bot: deploy 1765554330: hotfix/sync-seat-state -> canary

dan_eng: Patch applied. Reconciliation command: `admin seats reconcile --org VR0-51 --dry=false` returned: 3 users provisioned, tokens issued. Logs: `2024-07-21T14:12:45Z reconcile: 3 -> provisioned for VR0-51`

vireo_poc: I see counts update now, thanks. A couple of users reported they had to refresh the page before seeing workspace access. We're still nervous about the upcoming exec review.

priya_enable: I can run a focused 20m enablement session today 16:30 PT, record it, and include a 4-question feedback pulse (ease, confidence, blocker, NPS-ish). Will include a short one-pager on seat visibility and token refresh.

maria_cs: Please do. @vireo_poc confirm 16:30 PT? I'll also open a renewal-monitor flag in CRM since they explicitly mentioned exec risk.

vireo_poc: 16:30 PT works, recording appreciated. We'll join with the two execs.

sfdc-bot: crm 1765554370: renewal_risk=monitor flagged for VR0-51 by maria_cs; link=https://sf.redwood/opp/VR0-51

maria_cs: Action recap:
1) dan_eng: follow up on reconcile metrics + monitor for 2 hours
2) priya_enable: run 16:30 PT recorded enablement + feedback pulse
3) maria_cs: send remediation note, one-pager, and paste feedback to CRM after session

dan_eng: Monitoring now. Will paste any anomalies to this thread.

vireo_poc: Joined the session, recording received, feedback submitted: ease=4, confidence=4, blocker="page refresh needed once", recommend=4. Comment: "good response time, minor UX hiccup"

maria_cs: Thanks all 4 will attach recording + feedback snippet to account and close loop if metrics stable. :tada:
